run_profile_analyzer: run the profile analyzer on a latency trace file with --source latency_trace.txt --fmt simple
run_profile_analyzer_html: run the profile analyzer to generate an HTML report using --fmt html --out report.html
review_CallStackBuilder_add: review the CallStackBuilder add method that parses JSON trace lines and builds call scopes
review_ScopeBuilder_finish: review the ScopeBuilder finish method that computes self time and scope-relative timing for line items
review_percentile: review the percentile function that computes interpolated percentile values from a sorted list of numbers
